about: people2 skeleton (tools/blender/build_people2.py, docs/people.md). Game axes: x the person's left, y up, z forward (the person faces +z), metres. Bone frames are the glTF nodes' rest frames: local +y runs along the bone.

boneMap.note: The little finger is weighted to the ring chain (ring1-3), so it curls with the ring finger. Eyes are not bones yet (eyeL, eyeR are reserved for B, as leaves of head).

gripR.note: the right fist's grip: a handle runs along local +y through the closed fist (forward when the arm hangs); local +z points to the wrist, so a blade's edge points along -z (the little finger side). Model a held thing with its grip at the origin and its tip along +y.

gripL.note: the same for the left fist.

hipL.note: the left hip at the belt: a scabbard or sheath hangs from here along local +y (down).

back.note: the middle of the upper back on the skin: a slung load; local +y up the back, local +z out of the back (behind the person).

headTop.note: the crown: a hat sits here; local +y up.

nape.for: the back of the neck: a grab from behind

collarBack.for: the back of the collar: a grab or a drag by the coat

collarFront.for: the lapels: a grab from the front, a shove

mouth.for: a hand over the mouth from behind (a silent attack)

throat.for: a blade or an arm at the throat

chest.for: a blow or a stab to the chest

belly.for: a blow or a stab to the belly

beltBack.for: the belt at the back: a lift or a drag

wristL.for: a grip on the wrist: held, twisted, dragged by the arms

upperArmL.for: a grip on the arm above the elbow: held, led away

armpitL.for: lifting or dragging a body under the arms

ankleL.for: dragging a body by the feet

lod.note: LOD1 also for the mirrors and the lantern shadow

locomotion.about: package D1 clips (tools/blender/people2/clips_move.py, docs/people.md 'Locomotion'). Loops are two strides, in place: move the node at their speed. Clips that travel move the hips: move the node by their travel at the end. Hips translation tracks are the clip's own body's offset from its rest, added to man_middling's hips rest (trackBase).

blend.weight: neighbours by speed a < v < b: w = (Sa - v Ta) / (v (Tb - Ta) - (Sb - Sa)), S = stride, T = cycle (clip meta); mix rotations by slerp(w) and hips translations by lerp(w)
blend.phase: one shared phase for all loops (each is two strides, left heel at 0 and 0.5), advanced by dt / (2 T), T = lerp(Ta, Tb, w)
blend.ends: below the slowest or above the fastest loop of a family play its end loop at cycle = stride / v
blend.switch: walk to run (and back) as v passes 2.2 m/s: crossfade inside a window where both gaits agree (clips_move.switch_windows: one foot down in both, the other in the air in both), never held as a mix
blend.feet: lock the planted feet with leg IK every frame (motion.lock_feet does it here): blends move the pose, not the feet; measured with the lock: under 2 mm
blend.otherBodies: a clip made on one body plays on another of the same base unchanged; on a smaller or bigger body scale its speed and stride by the ratio of the hips heights (peopleRig bodies.<b>.hipsBone)

sack.note: a sack across the left shoulder, its length along the person's forward; centre given from the left shoulder joint (armUpL head) at rest; the left hand holds its front end

crate.note: a crate held in front against the belly, both hands under its sides; centre from the chest bone's head at rest

cart_push.note: the handcart's grips (props.glb handcart: HANDCART_GRIP 0.34 either side, 0.75 m up), the cart ahead; grips run forward along the shafts

cart_pull.note: the same cart turned round: he walks between the shafts and draws it behind him

truck_push.note: a sack truck tipped back toward him (about 45 degrees), wheels ahead, the two handle tips

truck_pull.note: the sack truck drawn behind him, tipped forward onto its wheels
